_comment: Synthetic fixture matching Zepp's run/detail.json encoding (not real user data) - used to unit-test decoder.py deterministically. 3 samples at t=0,10,20s, all channels aligned on the same timeline so no interpolation is needed to verify the math. speed/currentDistance/power_meter values are plausible-but-invented (not from a real workout) - currentDistance is in centimeters like altitude (confirmed live 2026-08-27: without the /100 conversion a real 20km ride decoded as 2017km).
